localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; specifically, vertical parallel lines on the right lobe and diagonal intersecting marks on the central-left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Alphanumeric identifiers 'HWC #7199' and 'YoNAH #2687' are present as high-contrast overlays in the lower region of the image.
